title: Minimum Absolute Difference Pairs

monster.name: Precision Wraith
monster.title: Seeker of Tightest Numeric Gaps
monster.defeatQuote: All coordinate pairs with minimal absolute difference collected!

description: Given an array of distinct integers `arr`, find all pairs of elements with the minimum absolute difference of any two elements. Return a list of pairs in ascending order with respect to pairs.
solutionCode:
def minimumAbsDifference(arr: list[int]) -> list[list[int]]:
    arr.sort()
    min_diff = min(arr[i + 1] - arr[i] for i in range(len(arr) - 1))
    return [[arr[i], arr[i + 1]] for i in range(len(arr) - 1) if arr[i + 1] - arr[i] == min_diff]
hints: Sort the array. The minimum difference must occur between two adjacent elements.
